Fist Ghainemeir is a human member of the Flaming Fist visiting Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing. He makes sexual advances towards  Irenya while slightly drunk.
“
Hells. You sound like an ogre thrust his spindle in a serpent.
„
— Ghainemeir

Involvement

Ghainemeir is apparently drunk and makes advances towards  Irenya. The party can attempt to intervene or let Irenya handle the situation. If a party member intervenes, Ghainemeir leaves Sharess' Caress and Irenya becomes annoyed at having lost a customer with deep pockets.
